Fwd: Readout: 12/7 Alphabet Global Election Protection - Lessons Learned and
Future Efforts Brief
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, December 13, 2022 at 11:32:11 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Rosarie Tucci, [contact omitted] Mark Billera, [contact omitted] Lauren Kirby,
[contact omitted] Laura McKechnie, [contact omitted] Laura Pavlovic, [contact omitted] Meral Karan,
[contact omitted] Joseph Taggart, [contact omitted] Michael McNulty, [contact omitted] Garth Willis,
[contact omitted] Kimberly Brown
Hi All,
I attended this at State last week. Sharing for a couple of reasons: 1) awareness; 2) we are engaged in a sub-IPC process
right now on engaging tech co's on atrocity prevention and key events. I did ask Google to follow up with an updated list
of countries they are focusing for 2023 and 2024, and also where they are scaling their localization, language, and
resilience building capabilities.
Please feel free to share as appropriate.
Vera

From: Frisbie, Alexis 0 < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Fri, Dec 9, 2022 at 1:31 PM
Subject: Readout: 12/7 Alphabet Global Election Protection - Lessons Learned and Future Efforts Brief
To: Zakem, Vera (DDI/DRG) <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Watts, Patricia < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Holmes, Corey W < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>,Dempsey, AlexL
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Hi Vera
My thanks to you again for attending this meeting on such short notice! I hope it was interesting/useful for
you. Please see the attached document for a readout. For a BLUF, please see the below:
(SBU) Alphabet Briefs Department Stakeholders on Election Protection Lessons Learned and
Global Election Priorities for 2023 and 2024: On December 7, Alphabet's Vice President of Trust
& Safety Laurie Richardson and Threat Analysis Group Director Shane Huntley briefed Department
seniors and expert-level representatives from GEC, CDP, DRL, INR, WHA, EUR, NEA, AF, SCA,
EAP, CT, as well as USAID, and DHS. Alphabet emphasized that they had seen fewer foreign threats
than expected during the 2022 U.S. and Brazil elections. Alphabet underscored the role and
importance of authoritative content in protecting global elections and information consumers in
general. Third parties that can support and corroborate results or information are critical to
Alphabet's Trust & Safety infrastructure. All parties agreed that resiliency building was essential.
Inquiries by USAID and State on resilience-building partnership opportunities with Alphabet were
raised, with company representatives concurring that this would be a great space to explore further
discussion. Alphabet also noted interest in cooperative programming on critical languages.
Following the meeting, Alphabet employees stated the importance of these conversations with seniors
included, noting that such an event held maybe quarterly would be great. Alphabet also suggested a
red teaming/threat ideation/hackathon collaboration between State, USAID, and Alphabet. GEC will
work with Alphabet and Department stakeholders to coordinate.
As always, if you have any questions please feel free to let me know!

Cheers,
Alexis
Alexis Frisbie
Senior Technology Advisor
Technology Engagement Team
Global Engagement Center
Department of State
[opaque block] [opaque block] [contact omitted]
SENSITIVE BUT UNCLASSIFIED
Vera Zakem
Chief Digital Democracy and Rights Officer
USAID | [contact omitted]/democracy
